newsitem.title: USA: Tenet Healthcare to buy OrNda - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Tenet Healthcare to buy OrNda - WSJ.

text.p: U.S. hospital company Tenet Healthcare Corp is expected to announce on Thursday an agreement to acquire OrNda Healthcorp for $1.82 billion in stock, the Wall Street Journal reported.
The newspaper said the board of directors of both companies approved the deal on Wednesday pending a vote by their respective shareholders.
Under the agreement, which is to close next March, Tenet would assume about $1.3 billion of OrNda debt, it added.
OrNda shareholders would get 1.35 Tenet shares for each of their own, it said.

"We spent a great deal of time over the summer talking to OrNda about partnering in certain territories," Jeffrey Barbakow, who heads Tenet, told the newspaper. "That turned into a wider conversation about joining formally in this arrangement."

The newspaper said the deal was expected to save $70 million through corporate overhead reductions, reduced interest expense and network consolidations during the year following the transaction's closure.
